detail: Red on set 55ff708a6: cloud2:/tank/fn/scratch/fill-wt/native-fill-resil-cloud2-55 (scenario_suite run resilience --allow-skips, jobs 3; logs/test-test_bp_fragment_node_native.log). Generation is 3 where the test expects 1: stale-scratch reuse or a changed journal numbering; read the test's setup before changing the node.
notes: 10-09 Builder D, traced on hbox at image d8fb738b3 with BRIDGE-SESSION-STORELESS-HEAP repaired (before it, the test died earlier, in the session's fn-bpa-encode). 'GENERATION 3' is the listener-generation line (BP NODE GENERATION ... LISTENER-FDS), not the journal's; the journal never selects a generation in the first serve. The first serve's whole output (hbox:/tank/fn/scratch/d-fixtures-schema/tenmib-first-serve.out, 1,311 sessions) has exactly one 'BP journal rotation in serve records=1311 threshold=1000', after the last session, and no selection: the test's kill lands inside that rotation. Mechanism, to be confirmed before any change: the serve asks for a rotation only in the :rotation service turn (books/bp-session-scheduler.lisp fn-bpsched-service, phase 7 of 8), and only at a safe point (fn-bpnrd-serve-rotation-due-p: no sessions, nothing issued, no pending image; host/native/bp-node.lisp:1262 also requires an empty held bank). While a sender's sessions arrive back to back, no pass reaches :rotation with no session open, so the rotation is starved until the sender stops: 311 records past the threshold here. The test (and SCN-077) expects the rotation inside the serve while the family is in flight. Repair is statement-first: a fairness statement that a due rotation is taken at the next safe point.
